changelog.subtitle: Every update, newest first.
changelog.r1200.1: Added the Console page to view, filter and copy the plugin's logs
changelog.r1200.2: Added this changelog, with a badge whenever an update brings something new

about.support.title: Made with love and care
about.support.body: This plugin is a one-person project, built in my free time because I love this game and its community. Keeping it updated takes a lot of those hours. If it has helped you, supporting me on Patreon means I can keep giving it that time. Thank you for being here.
about.linkHint: Click to open · right-click to copy
about.discordBody: Get help, report bugs, share ideas and hear about updates first.
about.githubBody: Browse the source code and every release.
about.reminder.title: A little reminder
about.facts.title: Did you know?
about.quotes.title: Words to live by
about.jokes.title: Just for fun
about.reminder.1: Been at it a while? Roll your shoulders and take one slow breath.
about.reminder.2: Hydration check. When did you last drink some water?
about.reminder.3: Blink a few times and let your eyes rest for a moment.
about.reminder.4: Stand up, stretch, and shake out your hands. Future you says thanks.
about.reminder.5: Sit up and settle in comfortably. Your back will thank you later.
about.reminder.6: Remember to eat something today. You matter more than any score.
about.reminder.7: Eyes feel tired? Look at something far away for twenty seconds.
about.reminder.8: Whatever you're chasing, you're allowed to take a break whenever.
about.reminder.9: You're doing great. Be a little kinder to yourself today.
about.reminder.10: A glass of water and a quick stretch can reset a long session.
about.reminder.11: Unclench your jaw and drop your shoulders. There you go.
about.reminder.12: Rest is part of the journey too. Step away whenever you need to.
about.facts.1: Honey never spoils. Jars over 3,000 years old have been found still edible.
about.facts.2: Octopuses have three hearts and blue blood.
about.facts.3: A day on Venus is longer than a whole year on Venus.
about.facts.4: Bananas are berries, but strawberries aren't.
about.facts.5: There are more possible chess games than atoms in the observable universe.
about.facts.6: Sharks have been around longer than trees have.
about.facts.7: A group of flamingos is called a flamboyance.
about.facts.8: Honeybees can recognize individual human faces.
about.facts.10: The Eiffel Tower can grow over 15 cm taller on a hot day.
about.facts.11: Hot water can sometimes freeze faster than cold water.
about.facts.12: A bolt of lightning is roughly five times hotter than the surface of the Sun.
about.quotes.1: Done is better than perfect. You can always polish later.
about.quotes.2: Small steps every day add up to surprising distances.
about.quotes.3: Comparison is the thief of joy. Run your own race.
about.quotes.5: You don't have to be great to start, but you have to start to be great.
about.quotes.6: Be patient with yourself. Growth takes time.
about.quotes.7: The best time to begin was yesterday. The second best is right now.
about.quotes.8: Celebrate the small wins. They count too.
about.quotes.10: Your only real competition is who you were yesterday.
about.jokes.1: Why don't scientists trust atoms? Because they make up everything.
about.jokes.2: I would tell you a chemistry joke, but I know I wouldn't get a reaction.
about.jokes.3: Why did the scarecrow win an award? He was outstanding in his field.
about.jokes.4: I'm reading a book about anti-gravity. It's impossible to put down.
about.jokes.5: Why don't skeletons fight each other? They don't have the guts.
about.jokes.6: What do you call fake spaghetti? An impasta.
about.jokes.7: Why did the bicycle fall over? It was two tired.
about.jokes.8: What do you call cheese that isn't yours? Nacho cheese.
about.jokes.9: I'm on a seafood diet. I see food, and I eat it.
about.jokes.10: I only know 25 letters of the alphabet. I don't know y.
settings.title: Settings
settings.languageHelp: The language of this plugin's windows. Job and Limit Break names always follow the game client.
settings.cat.whenToFireSub: How low a target's HP must drop before the LB fires.
settings.cat.targetingSub: Choose who the Limit Break lands on.
settings.cat.perJobSub: Give your current job its own rule, separate from the global threshold.
settings.cat.filtersSub: Don't waste the LB on targets it can't kill, and limit it to the right duties.
settings.cat.blocklistSub: Names here are never auto-targeted, even when below the threshold.
settings.cat.notificationsSub: Optional sound and chat cues when the LB fires.
settings.cat.combatHudSub: A small overlay with the LB gauge, your target and what the plugin is waiting for.
settings.threshold.typeHelp: Percent scales with every target's max HP. Absolute fires below a fixed amount of HP, whatever the target's max.
settings.threshold.fireBelowPercentHelp: The LB fires once a target's HP, shields included, drops below this share of its max HP.
settings.threshold.fireBelowAbsoluteHelp: The LB fires once a target's HP, shields included, drops below this many points.
settings.preview.percent: Fires when the target drops below {0}% of its max HP.
settings.preview.absolute: Fires when the target drops below {0} HP.
settings.targeting.autoSelectHelp: Continuously scans every visible hostile and targets the one with the lowest HP, overriding your manual hard target.
settings.targeting.scanRangeHelp: How far out to look for hostiles when auto-selecting.
settings.targeting.manualNote: Auto-select is off, so the LB only fires on the enemy you target yourself.
settings.perJob.noJob: Log into a job to set a per-job rule. The rule you set here applies only while that job is active.
settings.perJob.overrideHelp: When on, {0} uses its own rule below instead of the global threshold.
settings.perJob.usesGlobal: This job follows the global threshold from When to fire.
settings.perJob.presetNote: This rule came from a preset. Any change you make here turns it into your own rule, and presets leave it alone after that.
settings.perJob.modeHelp: Offensive LBs fire on a low enemy. Defensive and utility LBs are self-cast and fire on team conditions instead.
settings.perJob.offensiveBlurb: Fires on a hostile below an HP threshold.
settings.perJob.defensiveBlurb: Fires (self-cast) when your team is pressured: enough hurt allies nearby and enemies present.
settings.perJob.utilityBlurb: Fires (self-cast) in a committed teamfight: enough allies and enemies clustered, regardless of HP.
settings.perJob.allyHpHelp: An ally counts as hurt below this share of max HP.
settings.perJob.hurtAlliesHelp: Fire when at least this many hurt allies are nearby.
settings.perJob.alliesNearHelp: Fire when at least this many allies are clustered nearby.
settings.perJob.allyRadiusHelp: How close an ally must be to count.
settings.perJob.enemiesNearHelp: Also require this many enemies within range.
settings.perJob.enemyRadiusHelp: How close an enemy must be to count.
settings.filters.skipDoomed: Skip targets that will die first
settings.filters.skipDoomedHelp: If an enemy is losing HP fast enough to die before the LB lands (about a 1.2 s cast lock), skip it so the charge isn't wasted on a kill someone else gets.
settings.filters.skipGuardedHelp: Guard reduces incoming damage by 90% for 5 s. The LB would land for about 10% and waste the charge, so guarded targets are skipped.
settings.filters.skipInvulnerable: Skip targets immune to your LB
settings.filters.skipInvulnerableHelp: Paladin's Phalanx LB (Hallowed Ground) and Dark Knight's Eventide LB (Undead Redemption) make the target immune to damage for 10 s. The LB can't kill them, so these targets are skipped.
settings.filters.dutyFootnote: Auto-fire only runs in the PvP modes switched on here.
settings.blocklist.addHelp: Type an exact player name and press Enter. Blocked players are never auto-targeted.
settings.notifications.playSoundHelp: Plays a chat sound effect (the same set as /se1 to /se16) each time the LB fires.
settings.notifications.soundEffectHelp: Which of the sixteen chat sound effects to play.
settings.notifications.logToChatHelp: Prints a line to chat when an LB fires, for example "fired Seiton Tenchu on Striking Dummy".
settings.hud.showInPvpHelp: Open the HUD automatically whenever you enter a PvP duty, and hide it again when you leave.
settings.hud.lockHelp: A locked HUD ignores the mouse, so clicks pass through to the game. Unlock it to drag it somewhere else.
settings.hud.nowHelp: Show or hide the HUD until your next zone change, in or out of PvP.
settings.hud.footnote: Type /pvpautolb hud to show or hide it from chat.
settings.general.openOnLoginHelp: Pop the main window automatically the next time you log in.
plugin.commandHelp: Toggle the Auto PVP LB window. /pvpautolb config | log | changelog | about | hud (show or hide the combat HUD).
